summary: EA's co-op-focused third-person shooter series built around two-player tactics, aggro, and private military contractors.

entries.title: Army of Two
entries.definitive_edition: Original Xbox 360/PlayStation 3 release; Xbox 360 selected as primary route

emulation.emulator: Xenia or RPCS3 where legal and stable
emulation.notes: Original hardware and local co-op remain the reference route; use emulation only for owned-copy preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Seventh-generation console release, potentially improved through emulator scaling

primary.why: Army of Two released on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 only. With no PC or remaster route and no sourced content split, Xbox 360 is the practical primary pick and PS3 is an equivalent alternate route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360 version locally or on original hardware; use PS3 as an equivalent route if that is the available copy, noting that official online servers were shut down.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC port or modern remaster is documented in the cited public source; official online servers were shut down in 2011.

entries.title: Army of Two: The 40th Day
entries.definitive_edition: Xbox 360/PlayStation 3 HD version with Chapters of Deceit where owned; Xbox 360 selected as primary route

emulation.emulator: Xenia, RPCS3, or PPSSPP where legal and stable
emulation.notes: Use an HD console version for the main route; PSP is preservation-only.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: HD console version, potentially improved through emulator scaling

primary.version: HD console version with Chapters of Deceit where owned
primary.why: The 40th Day released for PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and PlayStation Portable. The HD console versions are the main route, while PSP is a lower-fidelity separate handheld version. Xbox 360 is selected as the practical primary route and should include the Chapters of Deceit DLC where owned.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360 version locally or on original hardware with Chapters of Deceit if owned; use PS3 as an equivalent HD console route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC port or modern remaster is documented in the cited public source.

entries.title: Army of Two: The Devil's Cartel
entries.definitive_edition: Original Xbox 360/PlayStation 3 release; Xbox 360 selected as primary route

emulation.emulator: Xenia or RPCS3 where legal and stable
emulation.notes: Original hardware remains the reference route; use emulation only for owned-copy preservation or scaling.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Seventh-generation console release, potentially improved through emulator scaling

primary.why: The Devil's Cartel released on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 only and is the third and final Army of Two game. With no PC/remaster route and no sourced content split, Xbox 360 is the practical primary pick.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360 version locally or on original hardware; use PS3 as an equivalent route if that is the available copy.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC port or modern remaster is documented in the cited public source.
